import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
center = ee.Geometry.Point(140.468626, -45.432798)
region = center.buffer(100000)  # 100km radius

# Time periods for comparison
period1_start = '2018-11-01'
period1_end = '2019-02-28'
period2_start = '2019-11-01'
period2_end = '2020-02-29'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua Ocean Color
def get_chlorophyll_collection(start_date, end_date):
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(region) \
        .select('chlor_a', 'qual_sst')
    return collection

# Get collections for both periods
col1 = get_chlorophyll_collection(period1_start, period1_end)
col2 = get_chlorophyll_collection(period2_start, period2_end)

# Check if collections have data
size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"2018-19 Images: {size1}")
print(f"2019-20 Images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Create mean composites and mask poor quality
    def mask_quality(image):
        quality = image.select('qual_sst')
        # Mask pixels with poor quality (bit 2 set = bad)
        mask = quality.bitwiseAnd(4).eq(0)
        return image.select('chlor_a').updateMask(mask)
    
    comp1 = col1.map(mask_quality).mean()
    comp2 = col2.map(mask_quality).mean()
    
    # Calculate statistics
    stats1 = comp1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=region,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    stats2 = comp2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=region,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    mean1 = stats1.get('chlor_a')
    mean2 = stats2.get('chlor_a')
    count1 = stats1.get('chlor_a_count', 0)
    count2 = stats2.get('chlor_a_count', 0)
    
    print(f"2018-19 Mean: {mean1:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count1)}")
    print(f"2019-20 Mean: {mean2:.4f}, Pixels: {int(count2)}")
    
    # Validation checks
    if mean1 is None or mean2 is None or count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif mean1 > 10 or mean2 > 10 or mean1 < 0 or mean2 < 0:  # Unrealistic chlorophyll values
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif mean2 > mean1:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
